note: Palau: a nonresident's work permit from the Division of Labor gives a foreigner legal status to stay and work there. RPPL 11-26 (signed 2 November 2022) exempts citizens of the United States, Micronesia and the Marshall Islands from visa requirements and the worker's identification card fees; the report names no exemption from the permit itself, so they're asked for it too. From newspaper reports.

sources.title: Island Times, Labor office says it is resolving numerous expired work permits (15 March 2019)
sources.said: The Labor division also reminds the public of the permit requirements and that a nonresident’s work permit provides legal status to a foreigner to stay and work in Palau.

sources.title: Island Times, Citizens of United States, FSM and RMI are now exempted from visa requirements and worker’s identification card fees (8 November 2022)
sources.said: President Surangel Whipps Jr. on Nov. 2, signed into law RPPL 11-26 which the immigration law that provides reciprocity on citizens of FSM , RMI and US.
